name: claude-activity
description: Local heatmap of your Claude Code and Codex CLI activity — hour × day grid, work/off/weekend breakdown, per-project session tooltips, daily token totals, and estimated API cost (per model, with historical pricing). Today's column is highlighted. Self-contained HTML dashboard built from ~/.claude/projects and ~/.codex/sessions JSONL logs; persistent history survives log pruning. No server, no telemetry.
